name: Dragon Chicken
subtitle: crisp chicken strips in a sweet, hot red sauce with cashew

ingredients.note: for the colour the dish is named for

prepNotes: Restaurant dragon chicken gets its red from food colouring. Kashmiri chilli does it honestly and tastes better.
The cashews go in whole and toasted, not ground. They are meant to be found.

steps.text: Coat the chicken strips in the egg, cornflour, maida and salt.
Deep fry on medium until crisp and gold, about 5 minutes. Drain.
Toast the cashews in a dry pan until they colour. Set aside.
In 3 tbsp oil, fry the dried chillies and garlic 30 seconds, then the onion and capsicum on high 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, kashmiri chilli and 100ml water. Boil until syrupy.
Toss in the chicken and cashews, coat quickly and serve at once.
steps.tip: At once. The crust softens within minutes of meeting the sauce.

storage: Eat straight away. It keeps 2 days refrigerated but the texture is the dish, and that does not survive.
